_comment: Use this when Claude Code runs on a DIFFERENT machine than FrameworX (Mac, VM, or a separate PC). Copy it over .mcp.json and replace YOUR-WINDOWS-IP with the LAN address of the Windows machine running FrameworX. Open ports 10150, 10151, 10120 in Windows Firewall on that machine. See KnowledgeBase/Method/mcp-setup.md for the full explanation and the auth model.
